com.ibm.cos.v2.awscore.client.config

Class AwsAdvancedClientOption<T>

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.ibm.cos.v2.utils.AttributeMap.Key<T>
      • com.ibm.cos.v2.core.client.config.ClientOption<T>
        • com.ibm.cos.v2.core.client.config.SdkAdvancedClientOption<T>
          • com.ibm.cos.v2.awscore.client.config.AwsAdvancedClientOption<T>
  • Type Parameters:
    T - The type of value associated with the option.

    public final class AwsAdvancedClientOption<T>
extends SdkAdvancedClientOption<T>
    A collection of advanced options that can be configured on an AWS client via ClientOverrideConfiguration.Builder.putAdvancedOption(SdkAdvancedClientOption, Object).

    These options are usually not required outside of testing or advanced libraries, so most users should not need to configure them.

    • Field Detail

      • ENABLE_DEFAULT_REGION_DETECTION

        public static final AwsAdvancedClientOption<Boolean> ENABLE_DEFAULT_REGION_DETECTION
        Whether region detection should be enabled. Region detection is used when the AwsClientBuilder.region(Region) is not specified. This is enabled by default.
